The JamesSuckling.com tasting team traveled to Alsace and reviewed more than 400 wines. In this video, you’ll find exclusive snippets of our contributing editor and riesling expert Stuart Pigott tasting an array of Alsatian dry whites at Hugel & Fils, which is one of the major producers in Alsace.
